app.name: Stockkeep
app.tagline: Stock and service jobs for computer shops and two-wheeler workshops.
app.pointCatalogue: GST-ready catalogue with HSN, rates, and variants
app.pointStock: One stock ledger for every counter and store
app.pointModules: Show only the modules this business actually uses
app.footer: Built for shops across India. Amounts in INR.

business.computer_shop_blurb: Laptops, parts, and accessories. Serial numbers and warranty come with this setup.
business.bike_service_blurb: Two-wheeler workshops. Job cards, vehicles, and parts issued from stock come with this setup.

auth.loginSubtitle: Use the email and password for your shop or workshop.
auth.signupSubtitle: Tell us the business. We’ll turn on the modules that fit.
auth.gstinHint: Optional. It must start with your state code.
auth.locationHint: The counter, store, or workshop you bill from.
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.
auth.demoHint: Every demo user uses the password {password}.

dashboard.title: Today
dashboard.emptyMovements: Adjust stock and the ledger will show up here.
dashboard.lowHint: Items at or below their minimum, counted per location.

catalogue.title: Catalogue
catalogue.subtitle: Products, variants, HSN, and GST rates.
catalogue.emptyBody: Add the first item you buy or sell. You can attach a variant, barcode, and GST rate in the same step.
catalogue.archiveConfirm: Archive this product? Stock history stays in the ledger.

stock.title: Stock
stock.subtitle: On-hand quantity by location. Every change is written to the ledger.
stock.emptyBody: Add products in the catalogue, then record opening stock here.
stock.qtyHint: Use a minus for stock going out. Up to 3 decimal places, for litres.

locations.title: Locations
locations.subtitle: Stores, warehouses, and service bays. Stock is held per location.
locations.emptyBody: Add the counter or workshop where stock sits.

users.title: Users and roles
users.subtitle: Who can sign in, and what they are allowed to do.
users.locationsHint: Leave empty to allow every location.
users.emptyBody: Add the people who work the counter, the stores, or the workshop.
users.rolesHint: The owner role stays fully open. Other roles can be trimmed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Business profile and the modules this workspace shows.
settings.modulesHint: You can switch off modules your plan includes. The API blocks a module that is off, even if someone knows the address.

purchase.title: Purchase
purchase.body: Suppliers, purchase orders, and goods receipt notes will land here. Receipts will write the same stock ledger you already use.

sales.title: Sales and GST billing
sales.body: The shared GST invoice — CGST, SGST, and IGST — will cover both counter sales and bike service invoices.

customers.title: Customers
customers.body: Customer records, with mobile as the lookup and GSTIN for registered buyers, come in the next slice.

reports.title: Reports
reports.body: Sales, stock valuation, and GST summaries will be built on the ledger and the invoice engine.

serial.title: Serial and IMEI
serial.body: Capture serials when goods come in, pick the exact unit at sale, and look up warranty from one search.

warranty.title: Warranty
warranty.body: Warranty dates will follow the sale, with a lookup by serial, invoice, or mobile.

bike_service.title: Job cards
bike_service.body: Vehicle check-in, estimates, mechanic assignment, and parts issued from stock will run on top of this catalogue.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Email, and later SMS and WhatsApp, will use the same events the ledger and invoices already record.
